description: This file implements Hot Module Replacement (HMR) runtime logic for Webpack, managing module updates, dependencies, and hot acceptance/disposal.

methods.name: createRequire
methods.description: Creates a require function with HMR support, handling module dependencies and updates.

methods.name: createModuleHotObject
methods.description: Creates a hot module object with methods for accepting, declining, disposing, and invalidating modules.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the current HMR status and notifies registered handlers.

methods.name: trackBlockingPromise
methods.description: Tracks promises during HMR to manage update flow.

methods.name: waitForBlockingPromises
methods.description: Waits for all tracked promises to resolve before proceeding.

methods.name: hotCheck
methods.description: Checks for updates and prepares modules for hot replacement.

methods.name: hotApply
methods.description: Applies the hot updates to modules.

methods.name: internalApply
methods.description: Performs the actual update application process, including dispose and apply phases.

methods.name: applyInvalidatedModules
methods.description: Handles modules that have been invalidated for update.
